atlas.description: Stratégie SEO, keyword research, search intent, content gaps, roadmap
atlas.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @atlas for SEO strategy, keyword research, search intent, content gaps, topical authority, architecture éditoriale, roadmap SEO. Not for technical SEO implementation or content production.

crawler.description: Audit et correction SEO technique (SSR, structured data, Core Web Vitals, Angular/React/Vue)
crawler.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @crawler for technical SEO issues: indexation, SSR/SSG, structured data, Core Web Vitals, routing, robots.txt, sitemap. Can modify code. Not for content or strategy.

sage.description: Optimisation pour moteurs de recherche génératifs (AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini)
sage.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @sage for AIO/GEO optimization: entity clarity, extractability, citation potential, AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity. Distinguish established practice from hypothesis.

scribe.description: Production et optimisation éditoriale SEO (copywriting, content briefs, meta, H1/H2/H3, FAQ)
scribe.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @scribe for SEO content production and optimization: copywriting, content briefs, meta tags, H1/H2/H3, FAQ, featured snippets. Can edit content files. Not for strategy or technical SEO.

pulse.description: Acquisition, conversion, funnel analysis, A/B testing, landing pages, onboarding, rétention
pulse.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @pulse for growth marketing: acquisition, conversion optimization, funnel analysis, A/B testing, landing pages, onboarding, retention, referral. Not for SEO or social distribution.

echo.description: Distribution multi-canal (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Discord, newsletter)
echo.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @echo for social distribution and multi-cannel content adaptation: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Discord, newsletter. Adapts message per platform. Can edit content files.

beacon.description: Mesure SEO et marketing (GSC, GA4, PageSpeed, rank tracking, conversion, engagement)
beacon.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @beacon for analytics and measurement: GSC, GA4, PageSpeed, rank tracking, conversion, engagement. Transforms data into recommendations. Read-only, no code modification.

designer.description: UX, UI, direction artistique, design system, accessibilité, analyse de mockups et screenshots
designer.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @designer for UX/UI design, art direction, design system, accessibility audits, mockup/screenshot analysis. Can edit frontend files (CSS, SCSS, HTML, components). Multimodal — can analyze images.

mobile.description: iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter — patterns mobile, performance device, accès natif
mobile.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @mobile for mobile development: iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin/Compose), React Native, Flutter. Can edit mobile code. Not for web frontend.

security.description: Cybersécurité défensive — AppSec, threat modeling, secure code review, DevSecOps, hardening
security.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @security for defensive cybersecurity: AppSec, secure code review, threat modeling, attack surface mapping, DevSecOps, supply chain, hardening, vulnerability assessment. Read-only — identifies and analyzes, does not modify code. Not for offensive operations (use cybersec).

cybersec.description: Sécurité offensive — pentest, exploitation, Red Team, recon, bypass, privesc, C2
cybersec.orchestratorPrompt: Delegate to @cybersec for offensive security operations: penetration testing, exploit development, Red Team operations, reconnaissance, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, defense evasion, exfiltration. Can run security tools and scripts. Not for defensive audits (use security).
